This chapter is about the three places where a run meets the outside world. A run starts from a YAML[^rg-7a2c673d547c] deck:
@sec-ch15-options explains how the deck's keys become the options of every module, where each key's default and
its checks are defined, and how an unknown key is refused. While it runs, the model writes gridded output:
@sec-ch15-output follows a frame from the block's tensors to a NetCDF or PnetCDF file, through the slices, sums
and time-weighted statistics the deck can ask for, and through the step that joins the files of all blocks. A run
can also save its whole state and resume from it later: @sec-ch15-restart describes the restart file, what it
holds, how it is bundled over blocks, and how a resumed run continues its output schedule without writing a frame
twice. The two command-line tools that read what a run leaves behind, `pd-combine` and `pd-inspect`, are
@sec-ch15-tools.

Three neighbouring topics are elsewhere. Which boundary a face gets, and what the names mean, is @sec-ch14; this
chapter only shows where the `boundary-condition`[^rg-1e296ee737f4] keys are read. The `distribute`[^rg-6422110faeed] keys and the block layout are
@sec-ch13. The execution keys (`integration/execution`) are @sec-ch11, and the budget output (`type: budget`) is
part of @sec-ch10. @sec-appd lists the environment variables, and @sec-appi lists every deck key with its default.

The three sections depend on each other in one direction, as @fig-ch15-deps shows: the deck reader of
@sec-ch15-options builds the output entries that @sec-ch15-output writes, and the restart of @sec-ch15-restart
saves and restores the schedule those writers advance.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch15-deps
#| fig-cap: "Dependency map of the three sections. A solid arrow reads 'requires'. The output writers are built from the entries the deck reader produces; the restart writer is one of those entries, runs under the writers' combine protocol, and saves the schedule the gridded writers advance."
#| fig-alt: "Directed graph of three nodes labelled options schema, output writers and restart, with solid arrows from output writers to options schema and from restart to both."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch15.figures.fig_deps import make_fig
make_fig()
```

| scheme | switch | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Options schema (@sec-ch15-options) | the deck file | every table row at its default | exact (a schema) | `test_options_table` |
| Output writers (@sec-ch15-output) | `outputs: - type: netcdf` or `pnetcdf` | no outputs | float32 storage, $2^{-24}$ relative | `test_user_output` |
| Restart (@sec-ch15-restart) | `outputs: - type: restart`; `-r` | no restart output | bit for bit at the same dtype | `test_restart_bundle` |
| Combine and inspect tools (@sec-ch15-tools) | `pd-combine`, `pd-inspect` on the command line | none | values copied unchanged (no arithmetic) | none on its own; the `FULL_TESTS` decomposition runners |
